create.name: Iyengar Yoga Birmingham
create.bio:
Iyengar Yoga Birmingham began life in 2002 as the Iyengar Yoga Institute of Birmingham, a title B.K.S. Iyengar himself proposed when he gave the venture his blessing. Its director, Jayne Orton, met Iyengar as a teenager at a master class in Oxford and went on to travel to Pune more than twenty-five times from the early 1980s, studying with him and his family; in 2010 he granted her Advanced certification. She has taught for around forty-five years, leading intensives and national conventions across Europe and North America, and she runs study groups on Indian philosophy.

The school owns its building on Westley Road in Acocks Green, a bright studio kept for Iyengar teaching alone and stocked with all the props the method uses. A small team of certified teachers, all members of Iyengar Yoga (UK), takes classes from a six-week foundation course and beginner sessions through mixed-ability and two-hour intermediate classes to an advanced class for teachers, plus a women-only group and classes for children. Several of Jayne's classes are also streamed online. Through the year she leads hybrid workshops, a four-day Christmas intensive with asana, pranayama and some Patanjali, and mentoring days for teachers working towards their first certificate.

courses.title: Beginner Level classes
courses.description: Weekly classes for newcomers to the Iyengar method, introducing the basic asanas, taught in the studio and, for Jayne Orton's classes, online. Booked ahead by 8am on the day.

courses.title: Yoga A Gem for Women (ladies only)
courses.description: A women-only class open to both beginners and experienced students, offered as a drop-in or in a block with the teacher.

courses.title: Advanced Workshop for Students and Teachers with Jayne Orton
courses.description: A three-hour afternoon workshop, in the studio and online, for intermediate students and teachers of every level, working on poses from level 2 of the Iyengar certification syllabus, with tea afterwards.

courses.title: New Year Light On Yoga Workshop with Jayne Orton
courses.description: A morning of asana sequences drawn from the courses in Light on Yoga, followed by Jayne's talk on building a personal practice, with time for questions. In the studio and online.
